message.subject: Gross margin around 70% for a coffee shop — quick question
message.body:
Hi Harbour,

I was looking at Harbour Lane Coffee Ltd on Companies House (company 11223344).

That is the sector figure, not yours. At that margin every £1 of revenue leaves about 70p before staff and overheads.

Is 70% close to your actual gross margin?

I built a tool that models a business as a connected graph — costs, volume and cash — and then simulates which change is actually worth making. For a coffee shop your shape usually has one or two lines that dominate everything else.

I can send you a one-page reading of what that would look like for you. No charge, and you will be able to tell in about ten seconds whether my assumptions are wrong.

Worth a look?

Jon Heaton
BAM, United Kingdom
